sectionOrganization.issue: In the Projects section, 'Riyadh Housing Prices Analysis (2024)' is listed before 'Student Attendance Dashboard (graduation project, 2025)', which is out of chronological order since 2025 is more recent than 2024.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Move the Student Attendance Dashboard project above the Riyadh Housing Prices Analysis so the most recent project appears first.

readability.issue: The bullet 'Worked on data cleaning tasks for the team' under the Junior Data Analyst role is vague, starts with a weak verb, and includes no measurable outcome.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite this bullet with a stronger action verb and a specific result, for example describing how many records were cleaned or what data quality improvement was achieved.

contentFormatting.issue: Certification dates are formatted only as a year (e.g., '2025', '2024'), while Experience and Education dates use the 'Month Year' format, creating inconsistency across the CV.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Format certification dates the same way as other dates in the CV, for example 'Microsoft, Aug 2025', to keep the date style consistent throughout.
